messages:
morgan (partnerships): NimbusHardware asked to co-host a joint webinar + live hardware teardown on Jun 3, 10:00am PT. They want 25m talk + 20m live teardown/demo + 15m audience Q&A. Can folks weigh in on AV and swag?

kai (events): We can do it virtual with a dedicated AV feed for the teardown. Need a camera operator and HDMI capture. Also recommend a 15m tech rehearsal 48h prior.

dina (marketing): Swag ask: 120 enamel pins, 80 hoodies, 30 mini dev-kits. Nimbus will cover customs for APAC if Redwood handles labels. Need co-brand artwork by May 20.

leo (eng-runtime): For the live demo I want a sanitized demo device and an isolated staging account. I'll prepare a fallback recorded teardown in case hardware stream fails. Health-check: probe device, if no response for 6s switch to recording.

eva (NimbusHardware): Confirmedwe'll ship one teardown unit to Redwood HQ. Ops contact: ops@nimbus.example. Uploading logos to shared drive now. We'll cover 50% shipping.

morgan (partnerships): Run order proposal:

 10:00  Intro + agenda (5m)  Morgan + Eva
 10:05  Redwood serving + infra notes (10m)  Leo
 10:15  Nimbus hardware teardown (20m)  Eva
 10:35  Joint demo + live Q&A (20m)
 10:55  Close (5m)

kai (events): I'll book two rehearsals: May 30 (AV check) and Jun 1 (dress). Will circulate invites after speakers locked.

dina (marketing): I'll assemble swag manifest and a size-collection form for hoodies. Need final speaker list by May 18.

morgan (partnerships): Action items: Nimbus provides tracking + ops contact by May 12; Leo provides fallback clip by May 22; Marketing provides co-brand mockups by May 20; Events schedules rehearsals by May 25.

deploy-bot: calendar event created: "Redwood x Nimbus: Hardware Teardown & Edge Demo" Jun 3 10:00-11:10 PT -- invites sent.
